sn22.85:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Sāriputto Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn22.85:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Yamakassa nāma bhikkhuno evarūpam pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti || ||
sn22.85:1.3: Tathāham Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi || yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maraṇā ti || || 3
sn22.85:2.1: Assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū Yamakassa kira nāma bhikkhuno evarūpam pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ || ||
sn22.85:2.3: Atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā Yamako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Yamakena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn22.85:2.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 5 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Yamakam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.85:3.1: Saccaṃ kira te āvuso Yamaka evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigatam upannaṃ || ||
sn22.85:3.2: Tathāham Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maraṇā ti || || 6
sn22.85:3.3: Evaṃ kho haṃ āvuso Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāmi || yathā
sn22.85:3.4: khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maraṇā ti || || 7
sn22.85:4.1: Mā āvuso Yamaka evam avaca || mā Bhagavantam abbhācikkhi || na hi sādhu Bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ || na hi Bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
sn22.85:4.2: Khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maraṇā ti || || 8
sn22.85:4.3: Evam pi kho āyasmā Yamako tehi bhikkhūhi vuccamāno thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharati || ||
sn22.85:4.4: Tathāham Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maraṇā ti || || 9
sn22.85:5.1: Yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu āyasmantaṃ Yamakam etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ || atha kho te bhikkhū uṭṭhāyāsanā yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.85:5.2: Yamakassa nāma āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhuno evarūpam pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigatam uppannaṃ || ||
sn22.85:5.3: Tathāhaṃ Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāmi || yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maranāti || ||
sn22.85:5.4: Sādhāyasmā Sāriputto yena Yamako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || || 10
sn22.85:5.6: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Yamako tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Yamakena saddhiṃ sammodi || la || || 12 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantaṃ Yamakam etad avoca || ||
sn22.85:6.1: Saccaṃ kira te āvuso Yamaka evarūpam pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ || ||
sn22.85:6.2: Tathāham Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāmi || yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maranā ti || || 13
sn22.85:6.3: Evaṃ khvāham āvuso Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi || yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maraṇā ti || || 14
sn22.85:7.7: viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.85:10.2: Rupā vedanā saññā saṅkhārā viññāṇaṃ tathāgato ti samanupassasīti || ||
sn22.85:11.2: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgato ti samanupassasīti || ||
sn22.85:11.4: Ettha ca te āvuso Yamaka diṭṭheva dhamme saccato thetato tathāgato anupalabbhiyamāno || kallaṃ nu te taṃ veyyākaraṇam
sn22.85:11.5: Tathāhaṃ Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāmi || yāthā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti param maranā ti || || 35
sn22.85:12.1: Ahu kho me tam āvuso Sāriputta pubbe aviddasuno pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigatam
sn22.85:12.2: idaṃ ca panāyasmato Sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā taṃ ceva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigatam pahīnaṃ dhammo ca me abhisameto ti || || 36
sn22.85:13.1: Sace tam āvuso Yamaka evam puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn22.85:13.2: Yo so āvuso Yamaka bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā kiṃ hotīti ||
sn22.85:13.3: evam puṭṭho tvam āvuso Yamaka kinti vyākareyyāsīti || || 37
sn22.85:13.6: evam puṭṭho ham āvuso evaṃ vyākareyyaṃ || ||
sn22.85:13.9: yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tam atthagataṃ || ||
sn22.85:13.15: yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tad atthagatan ti || ||
sn22.85:13.16: Evam puṭṭho aham āvuso evaṃ vyākareyyanti || || 38
sn22.85:14.2: tena hāvuso Yamaka upaman te karissāmi etasseva atthassa bhiyyosomattāya ñāṇāya || || 39
sn22.85:14.3: Seyyathāpi āvuso Yamaka gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo
sn22.85:14.5: tassa kocid eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetukāmo ||
sn22.85:14.7: Ayaṃ kho gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo
sn22.85:14.10: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ anupakhajja jīvitā voropeyyan ti || ||
sn22.85:14.11: So taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
sn22.85:14.13: tam enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapātiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya ||
sn22.85:14.14: so upaṭṭhaheyya pubbuṭṭhayī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapatissāvī manāpacārī pīyavādī || ||
sn22.85:14.15: Tassa so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā mittato pi naṃ daheyya
sn22.85:14.18: yadā kho āvuso tassa purisassa evam assa
sn22.85:14.19: Saṃvissattho kho myāyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā ti || atha naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropeyya || || 40
sn22.85:15.2: Yadā pi so puriso amuṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evam āha
sn22.85:15.3: Upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ tam bhante ti || tadā pi so vadhako va ||
sn22.85:15.4: vadhakañ ca pana santaṃ na aññāsi
sn22.85:15.6: Yadā pi so upaṭṭhāti pubbuṭṭhāyi pacchānipāti kiṃkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī pīyavādī tadā pi so vadhako va ||
sn22.85:15.9: Yadā pi naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropeti tadā pi so vadhako va ||
sn22.85:15.13: Evam eva kho āvuso assutavā puthujjano ariyānam adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānam adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.85:15.14: rūpam attato samanupassati || rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || ||
sn22.85:15.18: Viññāṇam attato samanupassati viññāṇavantam vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇam viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānam || || 44
sn22.85:16.1: So aniccaṃ rūpam Aniccaṃ rūpan ti yathābhūtam na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:16.2: aniccaṃ vedanaṃ Aniccā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:16.4: anicce saṅkhāre Aniccā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtam na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:16.5: aniccaṃ viññānaṃ Aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 45
sn22.85:17.1: Dukkham rūpaṃ Dukkham rūpanti yathābhūtam na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:17.5: dukkhaṃ viññāṇaṃ Dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 46
sn22.85:18.1: Anattaṃ rūpam Anattaṃ rupan ti yathābhūtam na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:18.5: anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ Anattaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 47
sn22.85:19.1: Saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ Saṅkhataṃ rūpan ti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:19.5: saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ Saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 48
sn22.85:20.1: Vadhakaṃ rupaṃ Vadhakaṃ rūpan ti yathābhūtam na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:20.4: vadhake saṅkhāre Vadhakā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:20.5: vadhakaṃ viññāṇaṃ Vādhakaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 49
sn22.85:21.1: So rūpaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti Attā me ti || ||
sn22.85:21.5: viññāṇaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti Attā me ti || ||
sn22.85:21.6: Tassime pañcupādānakkhandhā upetā upādiṇṇā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti || || 50
sn22.85:22.1: Sutavā ca kho āvuso ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī || la || sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.85:22.2: na rūpam attato samanupassati || na rūpavantam attānam || na attani rūpam || na rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ || ||
sn22.85:22.6: Na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati || || na viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ ||
sn22.85:22.7: na attani vā viññāṇaṃ || na viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ || || 51
sn22.85:23.1: So aniccaṃ rūpaṃ Aniccaṃ rūpan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:23.5: Aniccam viññāṇam Aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti || || 52
sn22.85:24.1: Dukkhaṃ rūpaṃ Dukkhaṃ rūpan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:24.5: Dukkham viññāṇaṃ Dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 53
sn22.85:25.1: Anattaṃ rūpam Anattaṃ rūpan ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:25.5: Anattaṃ viññāṇam Anattā viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti || || 54
sn22.85:26.1: Saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ Saṅkhataṃ rūpan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:26.5: Saṅkhataṃ viññāṇam Saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 55
sn22.85:27.1: Vadhakaṃ rūpaṃ Vadhakaṃ rupan ti yathābhutaṃ pajānāti || ||
sn22.85:27.5: Vadhakaṃ viññāṇaṃ Vadhakaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti || || 56
sn22.85:28.1: So rūpaṃ na upeti na upādiyati nādhiṭṭhāti Attā me ti || ||
sn22.85:28.5: Viññāṇaṃ na upeti na upādiyati nādhiṭṭhāti Attā me ti || ||
sn22.85:28.6: Tassime upādānakkhandhā anupetā anupadiṇṇā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti || || 57
sn22.85:28.7: Evaṃ hi te āvuso Sāriputta honti || yesaṃ āyasmantānam tādisā sabrahmacārino anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā ||
sn22.85:28.8: idañ ce pana me āyasmato Sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti || || 58
sn22.85:28.9: Idam avoca āyasmā Sāriputto || attamano āyasmā Yamako āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhāsitam abhinandīti || || 1 Evaṃ me sutaṃ ||
